jp: \t\t慎ましやかな花を咲かせる鉢植え。その控えめな感じが謙虚さの証であるとして、記念日の贈り物として使われることがある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t慎ましやかな花を咲かせる鉢植え。その控えめな感じが謙虚さの証であるとして、記念日の贈り物として使われることがある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant with modest flowers. Its modesty is sometimes used as an anniversary gift as a sign of modesty. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant with modest flowers. Its modesty is sometimes used as an anniversary gift as a sign of modesty. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà fiori discreti. Quel suo modo sommesso passa per prova di umiltà, e capita che la si regali negli anniversari. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「あたしこの花が大好きなの。だってほら、花びらが飛び散る鮮血みたいじゃない？」\n#～爆弾魔『ノエル』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「あたしこの花が大好きなの。だってほら、花びらが飛び散る鮮血みたいじゃない？」\n#～爆弾魔『ノエル』の言葉～\n"
en: \"It's my favorite flower. Well, you see, its petals look like splattered, fresh blood.\" \n# ~words of <Noel> the bomber~
en_grezzo: "\"It's my favorite flower. Well, you see, its petals look like splattered, fresh blood.\" \n# ~words of <Noel> the bomber~"
it: \"Questo fiore mi piace da matti. Perché, guarda: i petali non sembrano sangue fresco schizzato dappertutto?\" \n# ~Parole di <Noel> la dinamitarda~

jp: \t\t特定の動物の興味を引き付けて離さない鉢植え。適当な場所に置いておくといつの間にか猫だかりができる、という話だ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定の動物の興味を引き付けて離さない鉢植え。適当な場所に置いておくといつの間にか猫だかりができる、という話だ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plants that attracts the interest of certain animals and does not let go. The story goes that if you put it in the right place, before you know it, you'll have a cat crowd. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plants that attracts the interest of certain animals and does not let go. The story goes that if you put it in the right place, before you know it, you'll have a cat crowd. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che attira certi animali e non li lascia più. A metterla in un posto qualunque, dicono, senza accorgersene ci si ritrova un capannello di gatti. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t鮮やかな色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。その色は様々で、見る者をとても楽しませるという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鮮やかな色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。その色は様々で、見る者をとても楽しませるという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plants with brightly colored flowers. Their colors vary and are said to be very pleasing to the eye. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plants with brightly colored flowers. Their colors vary and are said to be very pleasing to the eye. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà fiori dai colori vivaci. I colori sono i più diversi e, dicono, rallegrano molto chi li guarda. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「え、くれるの？わーい大好き～」\n#～無邪気な少女『グウェン』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「え、くれるの？わーい大好き～」\n#～無邪気な少女『グウェン』の言葉～\n"
en: \"Oh, you're going to give it to me? Wow, I love it!\" \n# ~words of <Gwen> the innocent~
en_grezzo: "\"Oh, you're going to give it to me? Wow, I love it!\" \n# ~words of <Gwen> the innocent~"
it: \"Eh, me lo regali? Evviva, mi piace tantissimo!\" \n# ~Parole di <Gwen> l'innocente~

jp: \t\t育てるのに少しコツがいる鉢植え。別名花の宝石ともいわれるこの鉢植えは、まるで飴細工のような綺麗な色の花を咲かせるという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t育てるのに少しコツがいる鉢植え。別名花の宝石ともいわれるこの鉢植えは、まるで飴細工のような綺麗な色の花を咲かせるという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant is a little tricky to grow. Also known as a floral jewel, this potted plant is said to produce beautifully colored flowers that look like artisan candies. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant is a little tricky to grow. Also known as a floral jewel, this potted plant is said to produce beautifully colored flowers that look like artisan candies. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che per crescere vuole un po' di mano. La chiamano anche la gemma dei fiori, e dicono che dia fiori di un colore bello come le figurine di zucchero. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t目も覚めるような鮮やかな黄色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。まるでブローチと見紛う程の大きな花に成長するのもこの鉢植えの特徴だ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t目も覚めるような鮮やかな黄色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。まるでブローチと見紛う程の大きな花に成長するのもこの鉢植えの特徴だ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant that produces dazzlingly bright yellow flowers. Another characteristic of this potted plant is that it grows into a flower so large that it looks like a brooch. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant that produces dazzlingly bright yellow flowers. Another characteristic of this potted plant is that it grows into a flower so large that it looks like a brooch. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà fiori di un giallo vivo, da svegliare gli occhi. E ha anche questo di suo: cresce fino a fare fiori così grandi da scambiarli per una spilla. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t一本の茎から沢山の花を咲かせる鉢植え。甘い蜜を持っているとされるが、ノースティリスにおいてそれはしばしば猛毒に代わっているので、決して舐めたりしないように。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一本の茎から沢山の花を咲かせる鉢植え。甘い蜜を持っているとされるが、ノースティリスにおいてそれはしばしば猛毒に代わっているので、決して舐めたりしないように。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant bearing many flowers from a single stem. It is said to have a sweet nectar, but in North Tyris it is often deadly poisonous, so never lick it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant bearing many flowers from a single stem. It is said to have a sweet nectar, but in North Tyris it is often deadly poisonous, so never lick it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che da un solo stelo tira fuori molti fiori. Si dice che abbia un nettare dolce, ma in Tyris del Nord quel nettare spesso diventa un veleno feroce: non provate mai a leccarlo. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t立派に育った鉢植え。すくすく育つこの種の植物を、繁栄の証と考えて贈り物にする地方もあるそうだ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t立派に育った鉢植え。すくすく育つこの種の植物を、繁栄の証と考えて贈り物にする地方もあるそうだ。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Well-grown potted plant. In some regions, this kind of plant, which grows quickly, is considered a sign of prosperity and is given as a gift. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Well-grown potted plant. In some regions, this kind of plant, which grows quickly, is considered a sign of prosperity and is given as a gift. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso cresciuta in bellezza. Pare che in certe regioni questa specie, che viene su svelta, la prendano per segno di prosperità e la regalino. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t淡い色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。病気や害虫に強く、比較的育てやすい鉢植えだといえる。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t淡い色の花を咲かせる鉢植え。病気や害虫に強く、比較的育てやすい鉢植えだといえる。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant with light-colored flowers. It is resistant to disease and pests and is relatively easy to grow. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant with light-colored flowers. It is resistant to disease and pests and is relatively easy to grow. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà fiori di colore tenue. Regge bene le malattie e gli insetti, e si può dire che sia piuttosto facile da tenere. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t可愛らしい葉をした鉢植え。一人暮らしの令嬢の家には、大抵この植物があるのだという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t可愛らしい葉をした鉢植え。一人暮らしの令嬢の家には、大抵この植物があるのだという。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant with pretty leaves. The house of a young lady who lives alone usually has this plant. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant with pretty leaves. The house of a young lady who lives alone usually has this plant. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso dalle foglie graziose. In casa di una signorina che vive da sola, dicono, questa pianta di solito c'è. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t古の文字が刻まれた特殊な円陣。現在では形骸化しており、専ら部屋を飾るお洒落として用いられている。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古の文字が刻まれた特殊な円陣。現在では形骸化しており、専ら部屋を飾るお洒落として用いられている。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A special circle with ancient characters engraved on it. It is now a formality and is used exclusively as a fashionable way to decorate a room. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "A special circle with ancient characters engraved on it. It is now a formality and is used exclusively as a fashionable way to decorate a room. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un cerchio particolare, inciso con caratteri antichi. Oggi è rimasto solo il guscio, e lo si usa unicamente per far bello un ambiente. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t液体を保持する為に用いられる容器。どんな液体が入っていたのか知れたものではないので、使用するのはやめておこう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t液体を保持する為に用いられる容器。どんな液体が入っていたのか知れたものではないので、使用するのはやめておこう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Containers used to hold liquids. We should not use them because we don't know what kind of liquid they contained. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Containers used to hold liquids. We should not use them because we don't know what kind of liquid they contained. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un recipiente che serve a tenere i liquidi. Che cosa ci fosse dentro non lo sa nessuno, e conviene lasciar perdere l'idea di usarlo. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t見易い位置に配置できるように工夫されたパン屋の為の棚。値札が大きく貼られているのでつまみ食いは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見易い位置に配置できるように工夫されたパン屋の為の棚。値札が大きく貼られているのでつまみ食いは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves for the bakery, designed to be placed in an easy-to-see position. The price tags are posted so large that it would be better not to pick them up. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves for the bakery, designed to be placed in an easy-to-see position. The price tags are posted so large that it would be better not to pick them up. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale da fornaio, studiato perché lo si possa mettere dove si vede bene. I cartellini del prezzo sono attaccati bene in vista, quindi meglio non allungare la mano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t市井の情報が書かれた板。そこには町で起きた些細な事件やゴシップが貼り付けられている。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t市井の情報が書かれた板。そこには町で起きた些細な事件やゴシップが貼り付けられている。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A board with information about the city. There, trivial incidents and gossip that happened in the town are pasted. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A board with information about the city. There, trivial incidents and gossip that happened in the town are pasted. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola con su scritte le notizie della gente comune. Ci sono attaccati i fatterelli e le chiacchiere che girano in città. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t道等の方向を示す板。良く似た名前のものが存在するので、類似品に注意すること。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t道等の方向を示す板。良く似た名前のものが存在するので、類似品に注意すること。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: Board that indicates the direction of a road, etc. Be careful of imitations, as there are some with similar designs. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "Board that indicates the direction of a road, etc. Be careful of imitations, as there are some with similar designs. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola che indica dove portano le strade. Ne esiste una col nome molto simile, quindi attenzione a non confonderle. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t目印として用いられる板。良く似た名前のものが存在するので、類似品に注意すること。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t目印として用いられる板。良く似た名前のものが存在するので、類似品に注意すること。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A board used as a landmark. Be careful of imitations, as there are some with similar designs. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A board used as a landmark. Be careful of imitations, as there are some with similar designs. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola che si usa come segnale. Ne esiste una col nome molto simile, quindi attenzione a non confonderle. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t食品を蒸し焼きにする調理器具。内部に食材を入れて調理する為、何より調理人の感覚がものをいう器具だろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食品を蒸し焼きにする調理器具。内部に食材を入れて調理する為、何より調理人の感覚がものをいう器具だろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Cooking utensils for steaming and roasting food. Because the food is cooked by placing it inside, the sense of the cook is the most important factor. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Cooking utensils for steaming and roasting food. Because the food is cooked by placing it inside, the sense of the cook is the most important factor. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un arnese da cucina che cuoce i cibi al chiuso, fra vapore e calore. Si cucina mettendo dentro gli ingredienti, e perciò più di tutto conta il colpo d'occhio di chi cucina. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t流動した金属が注ぎ込まれた炉。それらの金属は非常に赤赤しく燃え盛り、周囲を明るく照らしている。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t流動した金属が注ぎ込まれた炉。それらの金属は非常に赤赤しく燃え盛り、周囲を明るく照らしている。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n"
en: A furnace into which liquid metal is poured. Those metals are burning very reddish red and brightly illuminate the surroundings. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~
en_grezzo: "A furnace into which liquid metal is poured. Those metals are burning very reddish red and brightly illuminate the surroundings. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~"
it: Un forno in cui è colato del metallo fuso. Quel metallo arde di un rosso violentissimo e illumina tutto intorno. \n# ~Verso una Lama Migliore~

jp: \t\t雑多な衣服が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雑多な衣服が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A small shelf on which miscellaneous clothing is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A small shelf on which miscellaneous clothing is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un ripiano con sopra vestiti d'ogni sorta. È un mobile che si sposta, e lo si può regolare dove cade più facilmente l'occhio. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t雑多な雑貨が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雑多な雑貨が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A small shelf on which miscellaneous commodities is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A small shelf on which miscellaneous commodities is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un ripiano con sopra cianfrusaglie d'ogni sorta. È un mobile che si sposta, e lo si può regolare dove cade più facilmente l'occhio. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t雑多な日用品が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雑多な日用品が載せられた小棚。可動性の家具であり、目につきやすい位置に調節することが可能だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A small shelf on which miscellaneous items is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A small shelf on which miscellaneous items is placed. It is a movable piece of furniture and can be adjusted to a more visible position. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un ripiano con sopra roba di casa d'ogni sorta. È un mobile che si sposta, e lo si può regolare dove cade più facilmente l'occhio. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t何でも収まるよう段と段とに余裕を持たせた棚。普通の棚と共に、広く愛用されている家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何でも収まるよう段と段とに余裕を持たせた棚。普通の棚と共に、広く愛用されている家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A shelf that has room between tiers to accommodate everything. Along with ordinary shelves, it is a widely used piece of furniture. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A shelf that has room between tiers to accommodate everything. Along with ordinary shelves, it is a widely used piece of furniture. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale con i ripiani ben distanziati, così da farci stare qualunque cosa. Insieme allo scaffale comune, è un mobile che tutti usano volentieri. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t書物も収納できるように作られた棚。収納に購入者のセンスが光る、自由度の高い家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t書物も収納できるように作られた棚。収納に購入者のセンスが光る、自由度の高い家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves made to hold books as well. It is a highly flexible piece of furniture that allows the purchaser's sense of style to shine through in its storage. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves made to hold books as well. It is a highly flexible piece of furniture that allows the purchaser's sense of style to shine through in its storage. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale fatto perché ci stiano anche i libri. È un mobile che lascia molta libertà, e nel modo di riporre si vede il gusto di chi l'ha comprato. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t当面必要ない物をしまう為の家具。中に物が詰まっている為、使用することはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t当面必要ない物をしまう為の家具。中に物が詰まっている為、使用することはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture for storing things that are not needed for the time being. It cannot be used because it is stuffed with things inside. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture for storing things that are not needed for the time being. It cannot be used because it is stuffed with things inside. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile dove mettere via le cose che per adesso non servono. Dentro è già pieno, e perciò non si può usare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t食器を入れる為に作られた棚。自由な間仕切りが付いていることで、多様な種類の食器をしまうことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食器を入れる為に作られた棚。自由な間仕切りが付いていることで、多様な種類の食器をしまうことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves designed to hold tableware. With free partitions, it is possible to put away diverse types of tableware. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves designed to hold tableware. With free partitions, it is possible to put away diverse types of tableware. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale costruito per riporci le stoviglie. Ha divisori che si spostano a piacere, e così ci stanno stoviglie di ogni tipo. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t比較的安価な材質でできた椅子。市民の殆どはこれを使っているという、ごく一般的な椅子だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t比較的安価な材質でできた椅子。市民の殆どはこれを使っているという、ごく一般的な椅子だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A chair made of relatively inexpensive material. It is a very common chair that most of the citizens use. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A chair made of relatively inexpensive material. It is a very common chair that most of the citizens use. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una sedia fatta con un materiale piuttosto a buon mercato. È la sedia comune per eccellenza: quasi tutti i cittadini usano questa. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t座る部分が四角形の椅子。丸い椅子とどちらが良いかは、殆ど好みの問題だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t座る部分が四角形の椅子。丸い椅子とどちらが良いかは、殆ど好みの問題だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A chair with a rectangular seating area. It is almost a matter of taste as to which is better, the round chair or the square chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A chair with a rectangular seating area. It is almost a matter of taste as to which is better, the round chair or the square chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una sedia con la seduta quadrata. Se sia meglio di quella tonda è quasi solo questione di gusti. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tポーションを保管しておくために作られたやや小さめの棚。どれがどのポーションかは並べた当人にしか分からないので、下手に取り出さない方が良いだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tポーションを保管しておくために作られたやや小さめの棚。どれがどのポーションかは並べた当人にしか分からないので、下手に取り出さない方が良いだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A rather small shelf made for storing potions. Only the person who lays them out knows which potion is which, so it's best not to take them out too badly. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A rather small shelf made for storing potions. Only the person who lays them out knows which potion is which, so it's best not to take them out too badly. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale un po' piccolo, costruito per tenerci le pozioni. Quale sia quale lo sa solo chi le ha disposte, e meglio non tirarne fuori una a caso. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t勉学を励むに適した机。固い素材でできているが、よく見ると机の隅に小刀で削られたと思われる誰かのいたずら書きが彫られている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t勉学を励むに適した机。固い素材でできているが、よく見ると机の隅に小刀で削られたと思われる誰かのいたずら書きが彫られている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A desk suitable for studying. It is made of hard material, but if you look closely, you can see someone's doodle carved into the corner of the desk, which seems to have been scraped off with a small knife. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A desk suitable for studying. It is made of hard material, but if you look closely, you can see someone's doodle carved into the corner of the desk, which seems to have been scraped off with a small knife. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo adatto a chi si applica allo studio. È di materiale duro, ma a guardare bene, in un angolo, c'è inciso lo scarabocchio di qualcuno, fatto, a quanto pare, con un coltellino. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t口の開いたつぼ。非常に壊れやすいので、中に何か入れるといった使い方はできない。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t口の開いたつぼ。非常に壊れやすいので、中に何か入れるといった使い方はできない。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: A jar with an open mouth. It is very fragile and cannot be used to put anything inside. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "A jar with an open mouth. It is very fragile and cannot be used to put anything inside. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un vaso con la bocca aperta. È fragilissimo, e perciò non lo si può usare per metterci dentro qualcosa. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t固く封じられたつぼ。中が気になるが、がっちりと封じられているので開けることはできない。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t固く封じられたつぼ。中が気になるが、がっちりと封じられているので開けることはできない。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: A tightly sealed jar. The contents of the jar are intriguing, but it is sealed so tightly that it cannot be opened. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "A tightly sealed jar. The contents of the jar are intriguing, but it is sealed so tightly that it cannot be opened. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un vaso sigillato ben stretto. La curiosità di sapere che c'è dentro viene, ma è chiuso così saldamente che non si apre. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t金属を鍛錬する為に用いる金属製の台。本来の使用法とは別に、槌で叩いて楽器にするという作り話の様な使われ方もあるらしい。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金属を鍛錬する為に用いる金属製の台。本来の使用法とは別に、槌で叩いて楽器にするという作り話の様な使われ方もあるらしい。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n"
en: A metal stand used for forging metals. Apart from its original use, it is also said to be used in a fictional way, as a musical instrument by striking it with a hammer. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~
en_grezzo: "A metal stand used for forging metals. Apart from its original use, it is also said to be used in a fictional way, as a musical instrument by striking it with a hammer. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~"
it: Un banco di metallo che serve a forgiare i metalli. Oltre all'uso suo proprio, pare ce ne sia un altro che sembra inventato: batterlo col martello e farne uno strumento musicale. \n# ~Verso una Lama Migliore~

jp: \t\t丁寧に磨かれた鎧。しかし良く見るとメッキで塗装されているだけの粗悪品の様だ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t丁寧に磨かれた鎧。しかし良く見るとメッキで塗装されているだけの粗悪品の様だ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Carefully polished armor. However, upon closer inspection, it appears to be a shoddy piece of armor that has only been painted with plating. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Carefully polished armor. However, upon closer inspection, it appears to be a shoddy piece of armor that has only been painted with plating. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Un'armatura lucidata con cura. Ma a guardarla bene sembra roba scadente, appena ricoperta da una patina di metallo. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t淡い光を灯す手持ち用の照明器具。手に持つだけで気分は大探検家だ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t淡い光を灯す手持ち用の照明器具。手に持つだけで気分は大探検家だ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: A hand-held lighting device that gives off a faint light. Just holding it in your hand makes you feel like a great adventurer. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "A hand-held lighting device that gives off a faint light. Just holding it in your hand makes you feel like a great adventurer. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: Un lume da tenere in mano, che fa una luce tenue. Basta averlo in pugno per sentirsi un grande esploratore. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t掘削用の工具。しかし、特になくても掘ることはできる。ティリスの民は屈強なのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t掘削用の工具。しかし、特になくても掘ることはできる。ティリスの民は屈強なのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: Tool for digging. However, it is possible to dig without any particular tool. The people of Tyris is just that strong. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "Tool for digging. However, it is possible to dig without any particular tool. The people of Tyris is just that strong. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: Un attrezzo per scavare. Però, a dirla tutta, si scava anche senza. La gente di Tyris è di tempra dura. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t誰もが一瞬心奪われるという椅子。触り心地もしっとりとしていて、まさに理想の椅子といえよう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t誰もが一瞬心奪われるという椅子。触り心地もしっとりとしていて、まさに理想の椅子といえよう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This is a chair that captivates everyone's heart for a moment. The chair is soft to the touch, and is truly an ideal chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This is a chair that captivates everyone's heart for a moment. The chair is soft to the touch, and is truly an ideal chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una sedia che, dicono, per un attimo rapisce chiunque. Anche al tatto è morbida e vellutata: la sedia ideale, si può ben dire. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t水分を蓄えておくために作られた容器。大抵は酒が詰められているが、盗み飲みをしようとした冒険者が誤ってスライムの詰まったタルを開けてしまったという話もあるので、無暗に開けるのは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水分を蓄えておくために作られた容器。大抵は酒が詰められているが、盗み飲みをしようとした冒険者が誤ってスライムの詰まったタルを開けてしまったという話もあるので、無暗に開けるのは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: Containers made to store water. Most are filled with liquor, but there are stories of adventurers who have accidentally opened a tar filled with slime while trying to steal a drink, so it is best not to open them unintentionally. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "Containers made to store water. Most are filled with liquor, but there are stories of adventurers who have accidentally opened a tar filled with slime while trying to steal a drink, so it is best not to open them unintentionally. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un recipiente costruito per conservare i liquidi. Di solito è pieno di vino, ma si racconta di un avventuriero che, volendo berne di nascosto, ha aperto per sbaglio una botte piena di melma: meglio non aprirne a casaccio. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた机。怪しい雰囲気漂う、落ち着いた家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた机。怪しい雰囲気漂う、落ち着いた家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A desk made to be installed in a bar. It is a calm furniture with a suspicious atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A desk made to be installed in a bar. It is a calm furniture with a suspicious atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo fatto apposta per stare in una taverna. Un mobile sobrio, con addosso un'aria un po' losca. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた机。大人の雰囲気漂う、落ち着いた家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた机。大人の雰囲気漂う、落ち着いた家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A desk made to be installed in a bar. It is a calm furniture with a mature atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A desk made to be installed in a bar. It is a calm furniture with a mature atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo fatto apposta per stare in una taverna. Un mobile sobrio, con addosso un'aria da adulti. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t非常に重い鍵盤楽器。かつてこのピアノを背負って旅を続けた、一人の演奏家がいたという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に重い鍵盤楽器。かつてこのピアノを背負って旅を続けた、一人の演奏家がいたという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A very heavy keyboard instrument. It is said that there was once a musician who traveled with this piano on his back. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A very heavy keyboard instrument. It is said that there was once a musician who traveled with this piano on his back. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a tasti di un peso enorme. Dicono che un tempo ci fu un musicista che continuò il suo viaggio portandosi questo pianoforte sulla schiena. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t綺麗に装飾品を陳列した小棚。見易いように二段になっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t綺麗に装飾品を陳列した小棚。見易いように二段になっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A small shelf with beautifully displayed ornaments. It is on two levels for easy viewing. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A small shelf with beautifully displayed ornaments. It is on two levels for easy viewing. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un ripiano con i soprammobili esposti con ordine. È su due piani, perché si vedano bene. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t山ほどの品が整然と収納された棚。選びやすいよう同じ種類に纏められている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t山ほどの品が整然と収納された棚。選びやすいよう同じ種類に纏められている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A shelf where a mountain of items are neatly stored. They are arranged in the same type for easy selection. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A shelf where a mountain of items are neatly stored. They are arranged in the same type for easy selection. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale con una montagna di articoli riposti in bell'ordine. Sono raccolti per tipo, così che scegliere sia facile. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t横一列に陳列された鎧。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t横一列に陳列された鎧。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Armor displayed in a horizontal row. It is not possible to try it on as it is marked 'Not for Trying on'. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Armor displayed in a horizontal row. It is not possible to try it on as it is marked 'Not for Trying on'. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Armature esposte tutte in fila. C'è scritto a lettere grandi che non si può provare, e perciò non si può indossare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t食事をする為に用いるテーブル。ほどほどの広さがあり、皿が有る程度乗っても重なり合う心配はないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食事をする為に用いるテーブル。ほどほどの広さがあり、皿が有る程度乗っても重なり合う心配はないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A table used for eating. The table is of moderate size, and even with a certain amount of plates on it, there is no need to worry about them overlapping. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A table used for eating. The table is of moderate size, and even with a certain amount of plates on it, there is no need to worry about them overlapping. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo che si usa per mangiare. È largo il giusto, e anche mettendoci su un bel po' di piatti non c'è da temere che si accavallino. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t洒落た雰囲気が漂う、今風のテーブル。現在の人気は一色に染め上げたシンプルなタイプ、らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t洒落た雰囲気が漂う、今風のテーブル。現在の人気は一色に染め上げたシンプルなタイプ、らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This table has a stylish atmosphere and is very current. Currently, the most popular type seems to be the simple type dyed in one color. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This table has a stylish atmosphere and is very current. Currently, the most popular type seems to be the simple type dyed in one color. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo all'ultima moda, con addosso un'aria elegante. Adesso, pare, va per la maggiore il tipo semplice, tinto tutto di un colore solo. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t主に子供が遊ぶ為に用いる遊具。時代がすすむにつれ、より複雑に、より高級になっていくので、いつの世も大人を悩ます頭痛の種である。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t主に子供が遊ぶ為に用いる遊具。時代がすすむにつれ、より複雑に、より高級になっていくので、いつの世も大人を悩ます頭痛の種である。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: Toys mainly used for children to play with. As time goes by, they become more complicated and more luxurious, which is always a headache for adults. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "Toys mainly used for children to play with. As time goes by, they become more complicated and more luxurious, which is always a headache for adults. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un gioco che serve soprattutto ai bambini per divertirsi. Col passare del tempo si fa sempre più complicato e sempre più caro, ed è in ogni epoca il cruccio dei grandi. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t布の中に綿をつめて縫い上げた人形。そこには綿の他に様々な思い出も詰め込まれているという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t布の中に綿をつめて縫い上げた人形。そこには綿の他に様々な思い出も詰め込まれているという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: The dolls are sewn with cotton stuffed into the cloth. It is said that various memories are stuffed into the cloth as well as the cotton. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "The dolls are sewn with cotton stuffed into the cloth. It is said that various memories are stuffed into the cloth as well as the cotton. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Una bambola cucita riempiendo la stoffa di ovatta. Dentro, dicono, oltre all'ovatta è stipata una quantità di ricordi. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t比較的安価な材質でできた寝具。市民の殆どはこれで寝起きしているという、ごく一般的なベッドだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t比較的安価な材質でできた寝具。市民の殆どはこれで寝起きしているという、ごく一般的なベッドだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Bedding made of relatively inexpensive materials. It is a very common bed, with most of the citizens sleeping and waking up in it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Bedding made of relatively inexpensive materials. It is a very common bed, with most of the citizens sleeping and waking up in it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio fatto con un materiale piuttosto a buon mercato. È il letto comune per eccellenza: quasi tutti i cittadini dormono in questo. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tしっとりとした面持ちの格調ある箪笥。人は誰しもこの箪笥の中に隠し財産をしまっておくのだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tしっとりとした面持ちの格調ある箪笥。人は誰しもこの箪笥の中に隠し財産をしまっておくのだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A prestigious chest of drawers with a moist surface. It is said that every person keeps his or her hidden possessions in these chests. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A prestigious chest of drawers with a moist surface. It is said that every person keeps his or her hidden possessions in these chests. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassettiera di gran classe, dall'aspetto morbido e pacato. Dicono che ognuno, nessuno escluso, tenga in una di queste il proprio tesoro nascosto. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t家具屋でよく売られている書物を収める為の棚。特に目立った悪い点もいい点も無く、無難な出来栄えとなっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t家具屋でよく売られている書物を収める為の棚。特に目立った悪い点もいい点も無く、無難な出来栄えとなっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves to hold books, often sold in furniture stores. There is nothing particularly bad or good about it, and it is a safe workmanship. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves to hold books, often sold in furniture stores. There is nothing particularly bad or good about it, and it is a safe workmanship. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale per riporre i libri, di quelli che si trovano spesso dai mobilieri. Non ha difetti né pregi che saltino all'occhio: una fattura senza rischi. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t座る部分が円形の椅子。四角い椅子とどちらが良いかは、殆ど好みの問題だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t座る部分が円形の椅子。四角い椅子とどちらが良いかは、殆ど好みの問題だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A chair with a circular seating area. It is almost a matter of taste as to which is better, the square chair or the round chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A chair with a circular seating area. It is almost a matter of taste as to which is better, the square chair or the round chair. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno sgabello con la seduta tonda. Se sia meglio di quella quadrata è quasi solo questione di gusti. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t古の言語が刻まれた硬い板。読み解くことはできないが、歴史に触れたい市民が稀に購入するようだ。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古の言語が刻まれた硬い板。読み解くことはできないが、歴史に触れたい市民が稀に購入するようだ。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: A stone slab with an ancient language inscribed on it. It cannot be deciphered, but it seems to be purchased on rare occasions by citizens who want to experience history. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "A stone slab with an ancient language inscribed on it. It cannot be deciphered, but it seems to be purchased on rare occasions by citizens who want to experience history. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una tavola dura, incisa in una lingua antica. Non si riesce a decifrarla, ma pare che ogni tanto la compri qualche cittadino che vuole toccare la storia con mano. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t「自分の放った言葉が悠久の存在となるのは、一体どんな気分なのでしょうね」\n#～歴史を学ぶ『エリステア』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「自分の放った言葉が悠久の存在となるのは、一体どんな気分なのでしょうね」\n#～歴史を学ぶ『エリステア』の言葉～\n"
en: \"I wonder how it feels to have your words become eternal.\" \n# ~words of <Erystia> the scholar of history~
en_grezzo: "\"I wonder how it feels to have your words become eternal.\" \n# ~words of <Erystia> the scholar of history~"
it: \"Chissà che effetto fa sapere che le parole che hai pronunciato diventeranno una cosa eterna\" \n# ~Parole di <Erystia> la studiosa di storia~
